predecessors.name: Spanish East Indies
predecessors.text: the territory 'most of which it occupied except Manila and parts of Mindanao' (infobox): the archipelago without Manila and, as the page does not say which parts, without Mindanao

successors.name: United States of America
successors.text: the territory 'most of which it occupied except Manila and parts of Mindanao' (infobox): the archipelago without Manila and, as the page does not say which parts, without Mindanao

ledger.x: 23 January 1899: the Revolutionary Government becomes the First Philippine Republic (Malolos Republic).
1900: the republic shrinks to northern Luzon.
19 April 1901: the republic is dissolved de jure.
19 April 1901: the First Philippine Republic ends de jure with Aguinaldo's allegiance to the United States; the infobox puts the de facto end at 16 April 1902.

wars.name: Philippine-American War
wars.outcome: American victory: Malolos captured on 31 March 1899, the republic's seat chased north to Palanan, Aguinaldo captured on 23 March 1901 and the republic dissolved de jure on 19 April 1901 (de facto 16 April 1902).

certainty.note: No map on the page; the republic's 'territory controlled' is stated only as most of the archipelago except Manila and parts of Mindanao, and shrank as a guerrilla republic.
